capture.text:
Director of Manufacturing

 POSITION SUMMARY
 Weaver Popcorn is seeking an experienced manufacturing leader to direct the Malden, Missouri operation and strengthen safety, quality, service, cost performance, throughput, and associate development. The Director of Manufacturing provides strategic and hands-on leadership for plant operations, maintenance, sanitation, scheduling, grower partnership, and continuous improvement while ensuring reliable execution of annual operating priorities.

 This leader will establish clear performance expectations, develop plant leadership and frontline capability, optimize equipment and labor effectiveness, and partner across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement to deliver sustainable operational and financial results.

HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?Manufacturing & Operational Leadership
 
 Lead the Malden manufacturing operation with accountability for safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, sanitation, labor effectiveness, and overall plant performance.

 Establish clear operational standards, performance goals, equipment expectations, and operating cost objectives aligned with the annual plan.

 Drive reliable production output and efficient growth by ensuring the right equipment, staffing, operating systems, and performance measures are in place.

 Lead regular operating reviews with plant leadership to evaluate productivity, downtime, quality, staffing, schedule attainment, and corrective actions.

 Ensure manufacturing systems, procedures, and policies are consistently deployed, understood, and followed across assigned operations.

 Align internal manufacturing capabilities with customer needs, production schedules, raw-material availability, and growth expectations.

 
Safety, Quality & Food Manufacturing Compliance
 
 Provide visible leadership for a safe workplace and hold leaders accountable for proactive hazard identification, corrective action, training, and compliance.

 Partner closely with Quality leadership to ensure compliance with food safety and quality requirements, including HACCP, GMPs, sanitation standards, product controls, and applicable regulatory and customer requirements.

 Support disciplined investigation and sustainable corrective action for safety events, quality deviations, operational failures, customer concerns, and recurring performance issues.

 Ensure plant practices support audit readiness, traceability, sanitation effectiveness, and consistent production of safe, conforming product.

 Reinforce the authority and responsibility to stop or correct work when safety, food safety, quality, or regulatory requirements are not being met.

 
Continuous Improvement, Reliability & Capital
 
 Deploy Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, yield, reliability, labor efficiency, and cost performance.

 Identify operational failures and constraints, establish root causes, implement corrective actions, and verify sustained effectiveness.

 Develop and maintain meaningful manufacturing KPIs and equipment-efficiency measures that support timely, fact-based decisions.

 Partner with Maintenance and plant leaders to improve equipment reliability, preventive maintenance effectiveness, space utilization, and production capacity.

 Jointly establish capital expenditure priorities and lead effective execution of approved capital and process-improvement projects.

 Challenge existing practices, standardize successful improvements, and build continuous-improvement capability throughout the operation.

 
Grower, Supply Chain & Cross-Functional Partnership
 
 Collaborate with Field Operations to support grower relationships, contracted acreage plans, raw-material supply, and growth objectives.

 Partner with Supply Chain and plant scheduling teams to balance customer requirements, inventory, capacity, labor, and raw-material availability.

 Work with Finance and Information Technology to strengthen business processes, operating data, management reporting, budgeting, and decision-support tools.

 Contribute the manufacturing perspective to companywide initiatives led by Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Quality, and other functional leaders.

 Communicate operational risks, priorities, tradeoffs, and performance clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

 
People Leadership & Talent Development
 
 Lead, coach, and develop plant leaders and assigned functional leaders; establish clear goals, accountabilities, performance expectations, and development plans.

 Build a culture of excellence, ownership, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement at every level of the operation.

 Develop internal talent, strengthen succession readiness, and partner with Human Resources to recruit and retain a capable workforce.

 Build associate competency through effective training, qualification, coaching, and skills-development programs.

 Use a visible, participative leadership style that communicates direction, listens for understanding, addresses conflict directly, and earns followership.

 
WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.

 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 10 years in a Plant Manager or comparable senior manufacturing leadership role; food or agricultural processing experience strongly preferred.

 Demonstrated success applying Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, equipment efficiency, labor productivity, yield, and cost performance.

 Experience leading workplace safety, food manufacturing quality systems, sanitation, GMPs, HACCP-based programs, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

 Proven financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L accountability, capital prioritization, and analysis of manufacturing KPIs and cost drivers.

 Demonstrated success developing leaders, strengthening organizational capability, managing change, and building accountability in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

 Ability to travel regionally approximately 15% and remain available outside normal business hours when operational needs require support.

 
Preferred Qualifications
 
 Leadership experience in popcorn, corn, grain, ingredient, food processing, or a related agricultural manufacturing environment.

 Experience leading capital projects, technical teams, maintenance-reliability programs, and high-engagement employee relations.

 Formal training or certification in Lean, Six Sigma, safety, continuous improvement, or project leadership.

 Experience partnering directly with growers or agricultural supply networks.

 
WHERE & WHEN WILL YOU WORK?
 This role operates across office, agricultural, warehouse, and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Manufacturing must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when safety, quality, customer, staffing, equipment, or other operational needs require support. Regional travel of approximately 15% is expected, with additional travel based on business needs.

WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?
 
 Strong, sustained performance in safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, and customer satisfaction.

 Improved equipment reliability, operating efficiency, labor effectiveness, yield, and cost performance supported by clear KPIs.

 Consistent execution of manufacturing, sanitation, food safety, quality, and operating standards.

 Disciplined problem solving that reduces recurring failures and produces measurable, sustained improvement.

 A capable and accountable plant leadership team with clear goals, stronger bench strength, and active development plans.

 Effective partnership across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement.

 Credible, visible leadership that builds ownership, engagement, and confidence throughout the Malden operation.

 
HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?
 
 Competitive compensation.

 Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.

 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.

 Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.

 Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.

 
EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
 Weaver Popcorn is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

 
 



 The role responsibilities are many, various, and not limited to those written in this document.

The Director of Continuous Improvement & Margin Management will improve the overall client value and carry out activities to achieve the best results.
 

 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES : This list is not intended to be all-inclusive, and other duties may be assigned.
 

 Responsible for designing, analyzing, and improving production processes to increase efficiency, reduce waste, and lower labor This role integrates people, machines, materials, information, and energy to optimize productivity and quality
 Lead teams of Continuous Improvement and Financial planning and analysis to enhance margins
 Create and report KPl's to senior management
 Conduct weekly meetings with Senior leadership to report the drivers for margin enhancement
 Work with Project management and Engineering for capital projects
 Work with Financial Planning and Analysis group to track and improve product yields and recoveries as well as economic considerations for opportunity costs predicated on relative efficiencies and productivity of labor.
 Work with managers, supervisors, subordinates, and trainers to develop and initiate a program that will help close the gaps that have been identified, thus enhancing the productivity and quality standards.
 Help prepare and maintain the detailed layouts, designs, develops, tests, and cost justifies for various tools, equipment, and machinery that may be required for various production
 Lead and deploy the best practices in the production organization by taking initiative to support continuous improvement in various production processes by reducing the tooling costs and improve the flow of material and review cycle times and/or labor utilization.
 Work toward achieving the production goals and objectives of the organization.
 Lead, facilitate, execute, and manage projects to reduce the costs significantly by implementing Lean/Cl and Six Sigma tools and methodologies. Identify and recommend improvements by applying the relevant principles.
 Develop methods to help reduce the cost without compromising on the people, safety, quality, and service standards to ensure increased efficiency and quality and make recommendations.
 Make optimum utilization of Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma tools to assist in preparing the feasibility studies and ensure that the costs incurred are justified.
 Evaluate various improvements that need to be done and create value analysis and look for ways to reduce the costs in the production and production support applications.
 Confer with the senior management and other related personnel to create layouts, equipment designs, and other analysis/improvement plans and clarify and resolve any relevant issues.
 Give directions to help in preparing the layouts, visual aids, and detailed drawings that will eventually assist in improving the production processes.
 Achieve cost effective designs and carry out research, design, and development work of the production process that would include full production value stream- barn, kill, cut, packaging and warehouse methods, production flow, and production equipment.
 Determine the root causes for those system inefficiencies and failures and make recommendations for changes in designs and the related processing
 Help identify the key areas for improving these standards and incorporate new techniques to enhance the existing operating standards.
 Train and mentor new staff personnel and assist other team
 Assist in preparing the documentation for the improved processes and ensure that the product designs manufactured are up to the standard levels.
 Work with Research and Development to analyze data and set
 Assist in the Feasibility Analysis of Capital Projects and develop ROI (Return on Investment)
 Identify the key areas for improving standards and incorporate new techniques to enhance the existing operating standards.
 

 QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the work environment, knowledge, skill, and/or ability required or preferred. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 

 

 

 EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, or related discipline plus 1 year of relevant experience. Must have Lean Six Sigma Green Belt. Experience must include the following: time and motion studies, project engineering, product development, and project management. Must have experience with Lean implementation and Lean tools including SOP and FMEA. Must also have experience with AutoCAD and advanced Excel, and certification in SQL. Must have experience with statistical analysis using Excel and Minitab and design of experiments. Domestic U.S. travel required 5%. 
 

 COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, and/or governmental regulations. Ability to present the findings and report KPl's to senior leadership team and guide the related departments. Ability to write reports and business correspondence. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from management, and employees. Must have the ability to influence and persuade others.
 

 LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read and interpret documents in the English language such as applications, training materials and procedure manuals. Must be able to effectively communicate with candidates, hiring managers and others within and outside of the organization.
 

 MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to use analytical software and present the findings to the operations and leadership team Ability to apply mathematical applications to practical situations. Must possess strong analytical and metric-based skills.
 

 REASONING ABILITY: Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical, diagram, written and/or verbal form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
 

 OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Strong personal computer skills and understanding of recruiting metrics and reports required. Must hold a valid driver's license due to periodic business travel.
 

 PHYSICAL DEMANDS: While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be required to move about the facility. The employee is required to sit; use hands to finger; handle; or feel/hold objects; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; speak, hear, taste, and smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vison, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Individual must be able to effectively work in a normal production environment where temperatures and noise levels may vary. Generally, the incumbent must be able to sit and use a computer for extended periods of time.
 

 MISSION, VISION, & VALUES: Must believe and lead STF's MISSION of producing quality pork products, igniting the passion and growth of our team members, helping our community thrive, and making our business prosperous. Remembering that together we will achieve more by working safely and cultivating an inclusive and empowering environment. Must believe and fully engage in STF's VISION of being a place where we all belong, working as one, to build our future. Must live STF's VALUES in all decisions, behaviors, and interactions, which include-
 

 

 

 SAFETY- Be committed to the safety and welfare of all employees through prevention, education, and awareness, with the ultimate goal of eliminating workplace accidents.
 

 QUALITY- Our customers and families depend on us to provide a safe, quality product, by maintaining the highest food safety standards and desired customer specifications. Must take pride in the products we produce and serve.
 

 DIVERSITY- We embrace diversity, experience, and thought, and actively strive for inclusive behaviors across our company and our work. By promoting these values, we aim to create a positive work experience that encourage a sense of belonging.
 

 COMMUNITY- Be a positive representative of STF in our community while supporting the organizations who work for the betterment of Siouxland.
 

 SUSTAINABILITY- Be a steward of the earth by managing our environmental footprint.

Pulse Biosciences (Nasdaq: PLSE): Join the Future of Bioelectric Medicine 
 Pulse Biosciences is a novel bioelectric medicine company committed to health innovation that has the potential to improve the quality of life for patients. The Company’s proprietary CellFX® nsPFA™ (nanosecond Pulsed Field Ablation) technology delivers nanosecond pulses of electrical energy to non-thermally ablate cells while sparing adjacent noncellular tissue.
 

 The Company is actively pursuing the development of its CellFX nsPFA technology for use in the surgical treatment of atrial fibrillation and percutaneously in a select few other markets where it could have a profound positive impact on healthcare for both patients and providers. Visit pulsebiosciences.com to learn more.
 

 Why Join Us? 
 At Pulse Biosciences, we are driven by purpose and innovation.
 Our Mission: To build a viable Company that designs, produces, and commercializes nano-pulse technology to improve and extend the lives of patients. To solve the needs of patients, physicians, and healthcare providers with high quality and high reliability products and services, developed in accordance with rigorous scientific, engineering, and clinical standards. We exist to make a positive difference in the lives of patients, physicians, healthcare providers, shareholders and our Pulse Biosciences team members.
 Our Culture: A community of creative, forward-thinking individuals tackling challenges with ingenuity and collaboration.
 Our Commitment: Hiring the best and brightest minds to advance our world-class organization.
 

 What You Will Experience 
 Culture and Purpose - Purposeful and rewarding work collaborating with bright and curious minds brings us together!
 Innovative Environment - An environment that fosters innovation to take products from concept to human use quickly!
 Growth Opportunities - Learning culture focusing on professional and personal growth and development that you can only get in a startup-like environment!
 Comprehensive Benefits - A variety of health insurance plans and supplemental insurance options, and 401k retirement savings plan.
 Ownership and Rewards - Stock options awards and Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) to share in our success.
 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid time off, paid holidays, flexible work schedule and wellness program, including onsite gym and mindfulness classes.
 Diversity & Inclusion - A commitment to providing a respectful work environment to our diverse workforce. 
 

 About The Role 
 The Vice President/Senior Vice President of Electrophysiology (EP) Catheter Manufacturing will lead the development, production transition, and global scale-up of a next-generation EP catheter manufacturing organization. This executive leader will be responsible for defining and executing the end-to-end manufacturing strategy, building a high-performing team, and ensuring successful commercialization through scalable, cost-effective, and reliable manufacturing operations. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cardiac catheter or EP device manufacturing, demonstrated success scaling production from launch to high-volume commercialization, and extensive experience managing contract manufacturers and manufacturing transfers across global regions.
 

 To Make An Impact, You Will 
 Develop and execute the long-term manufacturing strategy for EP catheter products from product launch through high-volume commercialization.
 Build, lead, and mentor a world-class manufacturing, operations, supply chain, and quality organization.
 Serve as the executive leader responsible for manufacturing readiness, production scale-up, operational excellence, and capacity planning.
 Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, and Commercial teams to support product development and market expansion.
 Define and implement a manufacturing scale-up roadmap supporting growth from approximately 50,000 units annually to 500,000+ units annually.
 Evaluate, establish, and optimize the appropriate manufacturing model, including:
 Strategic partnerships with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs)
 Hybrid manufacturing approaches
 Internal manufacturing capabilities
 Drive manufacturing process development, validation, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency, yield, and quality.
 Select, qualify, and manage global contract manufacturing partners.
 Establish robust supplier and supply chain strategies to support commercial growth and business continuity.
 Build and qualify a scalable supply network for critical components, materials, and assemblies.
 Negotiate and manage key manufacturing and supplier relationships to achieve operational, quality, and cost objectives.
 Own product cost strategy and achieve planned reductions in COGS from launch pricing to mature commercial targets.
 Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and operational excellence initiatives.
 Develop manufacturing KPIs and operating metrics to ensure predictable execution and performance.
 Lead manufacturing transfers and site expansions, including transfers between domestic and international manufacturing locations.
 Establish manufacturing capabilities that support global commercialization requirements while maintaining regulatory compliance and product quality.
 Ensure successful technology transfer, process validation, and operational readiness at receiving sites.
 

 To Excel, You Will Bring 
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in medical device manufacturing and operations.
 Experience at the Vice President or Senior Vice President level leading manufacturing organizations.
 Proven success scaling complex catheter-based or electrophysiology medical device manufacturing from development through high-volume commercialization.
 Demonstrated expertise in cardiac catheter, EP catheter, or related interventional medical device manufacturing.
 Direct experience with electrophysiology (EP) catheters, cardiac mapping catheters, ablation catheters, or related cardiovascular devices.
 Experience scaling manufacturing through multiple commercialization phases, including launch, growth, and mature production.
 Track record of delivering substantial COGS reductions through process optimization, automation, and supply chain strategy.
 Experience supporting commercial volumes exceeding 500,000 units annually.
 Deep knowledge of catheter manufacturing processes, assembly, automation, testing, and production scale-up.
 Significant experience managing Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) at commercial volumes.
 Proven track record developing and executing manufacturing transfer strategies, including domestic-to-international (OUS) transfers.
 Experience building global supply chains and qualifying suppliers for commercial-scale production.
 Strong understanding of medical device quality systems, process validation, and regulatory requirements.
 Strategic executive capable of building organizations and leading transformational growth.
 Strong business acumen with demonstrated success balancing cost, quality, capacity, and speed-to-market objectives.
 Exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills.
 Results-oriented leader with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
 Ability to travel up to 15% of the time. Overnight and/or international travel may be required.
 Ability to lift 10-15 pounds.
 

 Ready to Shape the Future of Healthcare? 
 Apply today to join Pulse Biosciences and help us redefine the boundaries of medicine with bioelectric innovation. To learn more about us, visit our website at www.pulsebiosciences.com.
 

 We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, age, color, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, religion, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. We will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.
 

 PRINCIPALS ONLY; UNSOLICITED CANDIDATE SUBMISSIONS FROM RECRUITERS OR THIRD-PARTY AGENCIES WILL BE CONSIDERED FREE REFERRALS.

capture.text:
Vice President, Global Product Distribution Quality 
 

 The Opportunity 
 

 Our client is a leading global medical technology company looking to appoint a hands-on VP Global Product Distribution Quality. Reporting directly to the SVP of Corporate Quality, you will be responsible for developing and implementing business strategies to effectively manage all global product distribution quality. In this role, you will lead the global product distribution quality organization and processes, holding quality management accountability for all captive and outsourced distribution centres across every entity worldwide.
 

 This is a genuine turnaround and organizational design mandate, rather than a caretaker or step-up role. You will step in to stabilize day-to-day operations, manage significant FDA and global regulatory scrutiny, and reshape the commercial quality infrastructure into a world-class function. For a seasoned executive who enjoys building progressive systems at scale, there is a clear path to expanded enterprise responsibility within 6 to 20 months.
 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Global Distribution Governance: Own quality management systems/compliance performance across captive/3PL distribution centres globally - alongside full P&L, budget, and headcount accountability for the function.
 Turnaround & Future-State Design: Audit current teams, workflows, and systems to close compliance gaps, restructuring the global commercial quality organization into a streamlined, best-in-class model.
 FDA & Global Regulatory Execution: Act as the single accountable global executive for all distribution-related regulatory inspections, audit responses, and direct agency communications, including intensive FDA engagement.
 Quality Systems & Digital Traceability: Direct the IT partnership to optimize warehouse management systems (WMS), end-to-end product traceability, inventory controls, and nonconforming product containment.
 Enterprise Leadership: Serve as the global subject matter expert for distribution quality and contribute to enterprise-wide quality strategy as a senior member of the Global Corporate Quality leadership team.
 

 Candidate Profile 
 Sitting or Recent Med-Tech VP: Minimum 10 years of global organizational leadership at the Vice President level within medical devices, capital equipment, or adjacent life sciences—ready to deliver impact from day one.
 Post-Manufacturing & 3PL Mastery: Deep operational expertise in commercial, supply chain, and global distribution quality across multi-site networks (upstream supplier quality into manufacturing is out of scope).
 Proven Remediation Track Record: Demonstrated success leading quality turnarounds, organizational redesigns, and systemic remediation under active FDA scrutiny.
 Global Trade & Customs Compliance: Hands-on command of international medical device regulations, import/export laws, embargoes, import bans, and regional market-entry barriers.
 Academic Foundation: Bachelor of Science in a medical or applied science discipline
 

 What Sets You Apart 
 

 You lead from the front with high energy and a clear appetite for complex turnarounds. You combine sharp analytical rigor with executive presence, enabling you to influence across commercial, supply chain, and regulatory stakeholders while building high-performing global teams.

sourceEvidence.title: Sr. Manager Operations
sourceEvidence.quote: Job Description Ingram Content Group (ICG) is hiring a Sr. Manager Operations to support our Distribution team in Jackson, TN .  The Sr. Manager, Operations manages the daily operations of an assigned area within the Distribution Center and serves as a key partner to the Director, Operations. This role collaborates with the Director on hiring, safety and security, maintenance and repairs, non-product purchasing, and strategic planning to ensure customer service levels and commitments are achieved, while maintaining a zero-error environment. Want to join a key team that helps the world read? At Ingram, the Operations team serves a key role within the organization.  We ensure that our distribution centers and manufacturing facilities function at maximum efficiency.   Safety is a core value in our operations environment.  We emphasize this through training, education, and accident prevention programs.  Process Improvement is another core value, and through innovations such as voice and Radio Frequency (RF) technologies, as well as feedback from our associates, we work toward constant improvement. The world is reading, and it is our goal to connect as many people as possible to the content they want in the simplest ways.  If you want to be part of a customer-centric team that strives for excellence, collaboration, innovation, we can’t wait to meet you! Schedule: Monday-Friday, first shift, with flexibility to work weekends, additional hours, and provide on-call support as business needs require. What You’ll Need: College degree OR HS diploma or GED with directly related year-for-year experience 6 years’ experience in a high-volume distribution center OR production/manufacturing facility with a clear track record of success 5 years’ experience supervising at least 25 or more employees What You’ll Do: Achieve and maintain full working knowledge of all aspects of the assigned operation Implement a fast-paced, lean distribution system; drive the delivery of products and orders on time. Oversee KPIs, goals, and objectives for the management team; set clear goals and expectations for Managers and Area Managers, measure performance, provide feedback, and hold leaders accountable. Build a passionate team with a positive, inclusive, results-oriented culture; mentor and develop leaders and staff; manage staff selection and development, ensuring associates are fully trained and cross-trained on systems and procedures. Develop, manage, and lead continuous process improvement strategies and initiatives; leverage Lean, Six Sigma, and Performance Improvement tools to enhance productivity. Provide strategic-level/long-term planning (3, 6, and 12 months out), including labor planning, rate forecasting, and peak season planning. Work closely with support functions (HR, Maintenance/Engineering, Safety, IT, and other leaders) to build and secure support and resources for projects and initiatives. Ensure customer service levels exceed requirements and standards; works with management to improve cost-per-unit (CPU)/cost-per-line (CPL) while providing outstanding customer service. Collaborate with Senior Management in the planning, development, and launch of processes and strategies for the site; review competitive information and visit other companies to bring in new ideas on operations. Oversee the supervision of the operations area, ensuring the timely and accurate movement of materials into and out of the facility. Monitor and execute company policies and procedures for HR-related issues, including associate attendance, timekeeping, and performance reviews. Control and manage budget costs for all assigned departments/areas. Essential Physical Demands: Ability to walk and stand as needed Ability to grip/grasp as needed Ability to lift/carry in full range of motion up to 60lbs as needed Ability to push/pull in a warehouse environment up to 70lbs force to push as needed Ability to bend, squat/kneel, twist/turn, climb, crawl, reach above shoulder, and type/keyboard frequently Ability to work a flexible which could include nights and weekends Ability to travel as needed Exposure to wide range of temperatures Hiring Salary Range: $113,201k - $143,945k. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary for this position. It will be determined by factors including but not limited to:  the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, geographic location, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Additional Information Perks/Benefits: A highly competitive compensation package with generous benefits beginning first day of employment for Medical/Prescription Drug plans, HSA, Vision, Dental and Health Care FSA. 15 vacation days & 12 sick days accrued annually and 3 personal days 401K match, Life and AD&D, Employee Assistant programs, Group Legal, & more Encouraged continued education with our tuition reimbursement program Financial and in-kind opportunities to engage with non-profits in your community Company match program for United Way donations Volunteer opportunities and in-kind drives for non-profits throughout the year Casual Dress Code The world is reading, and Ingram Content Group (“Ingram”) connects people with content in all forms. Providing comprehensive services for publishers, retailers, libraries and educators, Ingram makes these services seamless and accessible through technology, innovation and creativity. With an expansive global network of offices and facilities, Ingram’s services include digital and physical book distribution, print-on-demand, and digital learning. Ingram Content Group is a part of Ingram Industries Inc. and includes Ingram Book Group LLC, Ingram Publisher Services LLC, Lightning Source LLC, Ingram Library Services LLC, Tennessee Book Company LLC, Ingram Content Group UK Ltd. and Ingram Content Group Australia Pty Ltd. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, work related mental or physical disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetic information. EOE-Race/Gender/Veterans/Disabled We participate in EVerify. EEO Poster in English EEO Poster in Spanish
